preconditions.description: The graph has between 1 and 1,000,000 vertices (n) and between 1 and 1,000,000 edges (m).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a_i, b_i) connects distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: not any(a_i == b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: The graph has no self-loops (a_i ≠ b_i for all edges).

postconditions.expression: all(x not in Q or y not in Q or not any((x, y) in edges or (x, z) in edges and (z, y) in edges for z in vertices) for x in Q for y in Q)
postconditions.description: No two vertices in Q are directly or indirectly connected by a directed edge (no edges between any pair in Q).

postconditions.expression: all(z not in Q implies any(x in Q and (x == z or any((x, z) in edges or any((x, w) in edges and (w, z) in edges for w in vertices)) for x in Q)) for z in vertices)
postconditions.description: Every vertex not in Q is reachable from at least one vertex in Q in at most two moves (direct edge or via one intermediate vertex).

postconditions.expression: k == len(Q) and all(1 <= v <= n for v in Q)
postconditions.description: The output consists of k distinct vertices in Q, where k is the size of the set, and all vertices are within the valid range [1, n].
